title: Every Event Type, Logged
description: Four different things can trigger a notification in SwiftCargo. Walk through all four in one continuous scenario and confirm every single one lands in the database with the right type — not just the one or two an incomplete test would happen to check.
successCondition: For a single customer, in order: book a shipment (shipment.booked), pay its invoice successfully (payment.succeeded), pay a SECOND invoice with the decline card (payment.failed), and advance the shipment to delivered (shipment.delivered). After waiting past the queue delay for all, querying the notifications table via `npm run db:psql` for that user confirms all 4 distinct type values are present exactly once each: 'shipment.booked', 'payment.succeeded', 'payment.failed', 'shipment.delivered' — none missing, none duplicated.
hints: The full trigger -> type -> title -> channel table is documented in docs/api/notifications.md — use it as your checklist for exactly which 4 to expect.

You'll need a second shipment/invoice to get a payment.failed entry without derailing the first shipment's payment.succeeded — don't try to decline and then re-pay the same invoice, since that invoice's SECOND payment would be the succeeded one and you'd only ever see one of the two outcomes per invoice at a time in this particular walkthrough.
